Choose a sense or point of contact that works for you. Breathing exercises, closed eyes, and inward body focus are optional. If this feels unsettling, pause and choose external orientation or support.

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" title="A worked example"}
While waiting for an online class, Priya notices the edge of her desk and the sound of a fan. When planning thoughts interrupt, she returns to the desk, then opens her class notes. She does not have to empty her mind.
:::

## Source and further learning

Original Free Therapy Tools prompts informed by Russ Harris, [*The Happiness Trap*](https://thehappinesstrap.com/) (supplied 33-chapter edition), Chapters 17-20. This is an independent educational exercise, not a reproduction of the book's worksheets.
